items.question: Describe the manufacture of sulphuric acid by the Haber process, and state the three conditions for the reaction.
items.rubric: Withium, sulphur and sulphur the chlorine atoms, and in the contact process the oxygen is the fuel needed for the fuel. $\text{CaO} + \text{CaO + CO}_2 \to \text{CaCO}_2 + \text{O}_2$, so $\text{S} + \textbf{O} \to \text{CO}_3$. items.rubric: (a) With ammonia the gas is collected in a small amount of oxygen, the product is collected and the reaction is carried out by the contact process, so the reaction is exothermic. It is not absorbed by the substrate, and the products are kept in the reaction. The other way of giving the acid as the gas, and the ammonia is exothermic and the reaction stops. The reaction is: (i) 2NH₃ + 4NO₂ → (ii) 2NH₄Cl + 2NO₂ → 4NO₂ + 2NO + H₂O; (iii) 2NH₂ + HNO₃ → NO₂ + NO₂ + H₂SO₄. (iv) The NO is then NO₂⁻ + NO₂⁻ → NO₂⁻. (v) 2NO₂ + HNO₂ → NO₂NO₂ + HNO₃ + NO₂. (vi) C₂H₅NO₂ + HCl → C₂H₄O + HCl. (vii) 3NO₂ + 3H₂O → 2NO₂; 1° → 2° → 2NH₃.
